summary: A proposal to park a temporary library raises a choice about which public space it would occupy.
realLife: In their submission to the trustees, South End advocates described considering an accessible vehicle or trailer in the park, on a sidewalk or in street parking spaces.
inGame: needs: vehicle dimensions and proposed location.

turns.pulledBy: The street site can accommodate the vehicle.
turns.what: Staff mark the parking spaces the proposal would use.
turns.writesBack: The permit request identifies the curb space affected.

turns.pulledBy: The sidewalk site leaves too little room to pass.
turns.what: The working group returns to its other sites.
turns.writesBack: The rejected layout stays with the site comparison.
